violation_type.title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §744.2655(b)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date
violation_type.typical_finding: Three children's medication did not have the date that the medication was left at the operation.

finding_variants.text: Three children's medication did not have the date that the medication was left at the operation.
One child's ephinepherine auto injector was not in the original packaging and was stored in a ziploc bag.
There was medication at the operation that was not in the original packaging.
The operation did not have the original container labeled with the child's name that an epi-pen came in.
One child's medication is not its original container.

One child who has food allergy did not have the medication available at the operation during the inspection.     Children's medication/Epipen available at the operation did not have the date when the operation received the medication from the parents
